All of these specifications are on **page 5**, in the "Model specifications" paragraph.

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Layers | 12-layer decoder-only Transformer with masked self-attention heads |
| State size | 768-dimensional states |
| Attention heads | 12 |
| Context length | 512 tokens (trained on minibatches of 64 randomly sampled, contiguous sequences of 512 tokens) |
| Optimizer | Adam |
| Peak learning rate | 2.5e-4 |

**Related details (also page 5):**
- The position-wise feed-forward layers have 3072-dimensional inner states.
- The learning rate rose linearly from zero over the first 2,000 updates, then annealed to 0 on a cosine schedule.
- The 2.5e-4 peak applies to pre-training. Fine-tuning used a learning rate of 6.25e-5 for most tasks.
